audioNotShared.description: Your browser cannot remove the other participants' voices from the screen audio, so they would hear themselves again. To present a video with sound, pick a browser tab and turn on “Also share tab audio”.
audioNotShared.title: Screen audio is not shared
audioNotShared.updateBrowser: Or update your browser: Chrome and Edge can remove the meeting sound since version 141 (Windows 11, macOS 14.2 and later).
